source_license: Source regional geography paraphrased with attribution; no source figures, curves or velocity data packaged.
remaining_gates: Review Grand Banks branching and offshore eastern approach naming gates before length admission.

name: Azores Current
scope: OSW reference corridor from a Grand Banks branch-region gate near 40 N / 45 W, southeast to the Mid-Atlantic Ridge near 34 N / 37 W, then eastward toward an offshore Gulf of Cadiz approach gate. Excludes upstream Gulf Stream, North Atlantic branch, Azores Countercurrent, southern recirculation, southward branches into the North Equatorial/Canary routes and Gibraltar/Mediterranean inflow. No whole connected-system length.
layer: Surface-intensified eastward subtropical-jet naming context. Source long-term core analysis averages upper 1000 m; 2009 section samples deeper flow separately. No fixed-depth current axis or uniform full-width footprint reconstructed.
time_convention: Regional geography from Frazao et al. (2022), with 1993-1994 drifter and October-November 2009 section caveats. Selected vertices are neither the 1871-2010 model mean axis nor dated seasonal trajectories.
source_locator: Introduction, paragraphs beginning The Azores Current originates and East of the Mid-Atlantic Ridge: Grand Banks origin, MAR crossing, eastward jet and distinct recirculation/branches.
source_citation: Frazao et al. (2022), The Forgotten Azores Current: A Long-Term Perspective, Frontiers in Marine Science 9, 842251, doi:10.3389/fmars.2022.842251.

supporting_sources.citation: Martins et al. (2002), Surface circulation in the eastern North Atlantic, from drifters and altimetry, doi:10.1029/2000JC000345.
supporting_sources.locator: Section 3.3.2 and Figure 3: 34-36 N eastward flow toward Gulf of Cadiz; seasonal position/width inference inconclusive.
supporting_sources.role: Eastern regional continuation; no drifter axis digitized.

supporting_sources.citation: Comas-Rodriguez et al. (2011), The Azores Current System from a meridional section at 24.5 W, JGR Oceans 116, C09021, doi:10.1029/2011JC007129.
supporting_sources.locator: Abstract and section 2: 2009 meridional survey; 110 km widths and separate eastward/westward currents.
supporting_sources.role: Section context only; width is not along-current length and is not applied along the route.

coordinate_selection: All vertices are OSW-selected. Source names approximate Grand Banks and MAR regional locations; offshore Gulf of Cadiz gate and intermediate longitude/latitude bends are editorial. Alternative departure/approach gates and a slightly northern eastward corridor test convention, not observed seasonal variation. No source arrows, front, reanalysis axis or drifter tracks digitized.

alternative_routes.interpretation: Shorter selected origin and offshore eastern gate convention; not seasonal contraction.
Northern regional corridor with longer naming approaches; not seasonal migration.

scenario_rule: Three selected branch-region/eastern-gate/corridor conventions crossed with longitude and independent endpoint latitude offsets -0.05/0/+0.05 degrees: 81 editorial scenarios, not seasonal variation or confidence bounds.
method: Sum shortest WGS84 geodesic distances between successive OSW editorial vertices; no velocity field or current core is reconstructed.
map_land_check: All 81 routes, geodesically densified at spacing no greater than 10 km, avoid the coarse OSW atlas land mask in display coordinates. This is not a shelf-break, reef, bathymetric or high-resolution land-clearance verification.
state_relation_role: Editorial line/display-region crossing; physical current passage unresolved.
